deals.name: Gens Aurea S.p.A.
deals.notes: Gold/precious-metals trader (DVC Partners-backed). Institutional placement at fixed EUR10 (no bookbuild range); ~EUR101m raised (EUR111m w/OA), 10% free float, mkt cap ~EUR1.01bn. First trade 14 Jul 2026 closed EUR9.949 (-0.5%). Euronext PR is primary for listing; offer EUR10 and close from secondary reports, so verified=false.

deals.name: Ellos Group AB
deals.notes: Online fashion/home retailer. Fixed-price (no bookbuild range) at SEK60; all-primary 5.0m new shares = SEK300m (SEK345m w/OA); oversubscribed several times; cornerstones ~SEK203m; mkt cap ~SEK1,485m. Prospectus/pricing 7 Jul, first trade 8 Jul 2026; close not obtained.

deals.name: Savox Communications Plc
deals.notes: Defense/critical-comms; fixed price EUR10.72; ~EUR57.5m; multiple-times oversubscribed; cornerstones Elo, Tesi, Danske, DNB, Protean (~EUR26m).

deals.name: Bohus ASA

deals.name: Reaktor Group Plc
deals.notes: Tech consultancy; fixed price EUR8.25 (EUR7.43 personnel); ~EUR62.8m; cornerstones Ilmarinen, Mariatorp, SP, Danske, Aktia (~82% of offer).

deals.name: BioMar Group A/S
deals.notes: Rare Copenhagen IPO (aquaculture feed, ex-Schouw); priced DKK108; ~DKK2.7bn (DKK3.1bn w/OA); cornerstones ATP, Danske, DNB, Nykredit, TIND (43.2%); temp certs traded 28 May, shares 2 Jun. Bookbuild range not confirmed from primary.

deals.name: National Investment Fund of the Republic of Uzbekistan (UzNIF)
deals.notes: First international Uzbek IPO; GDRs on LSE (USD25/GDR). USD-denominated, not pence. Opened USD26 (+4%). verified=false: offer from secondary sources.

deals.name: Silex Microsystems AB
deals.notes: MEMS foundry; fixed price SEK81 (no range); ~SEK1.99bn; 9 cornerstones (~75%: Creades, AP3, Capital, Swedbank Robur). Large debut pop reported (+127% to +178.5% across outlets); exact close unverified.

deals.name: Auroora Group Plc
deals.notes: Finnish serial acquirer; fixed subscription price EUR5.20 (EUR4.68 personnel); ~EUR35m; cornerstones Aktia, Elo, Varma, OP (~EUR22m).

deals.name: Gabler Group AG

deals.name: ASTA Energy Solutions AG

deals.name: Czechoslovak Group (CSG)
deals.notes: 'CSG' = Czechoslovak Group a.s. (Czech defence/industrial holding). Largest defence IPO ever; largest European IPO since 2022. Fixed-price at EUR25 per prospectus (no bookbuild range); base ~EUR3.3bn (to EUR3.8bn w/OA); ~EUR25bn mkt cap (15.2% floated). Debut +28% (Bloomberg).
